read_file_into_numpy: read data from a file descriptor at a given offset into a numpy array using libc pread
resize_crop_image: resize and crop a source numpy array image region into a destination numpy array
pad_image_region: pad a source numpy array image region into a destination numpy array with specified row and column bounds
imdecode_image_with_crop: decode an image from a source numpy array into a destination array with optional crop, scale, and flip
memcpy_numpy_arrays: perform a fast memory copy from a source numpy array to a destination numpy array
